name: pooled_check_fires_no_length

history.text: Hi, does anyone have room for a remedial massage today?

expected_behavior: Fires the availability check: brief filler, then universal_router intent=category_availability_check, payload service_category="remedial_massage", no practitioner_name, no requested_duration_minutes (no length was stated).

name: pooled_check_fires_with_length

history.text: I was wondering if you had any times this afternoon around five o'clock for a one-hour remedial massage.

expected_behavior: Fires the availability check with service_category="remedial_massage" and requested_duration_minutes=60, no practitioner_name (no therapist named).

name: named_therapist_disqualifies_bank_gene

history.text: I'd like a remedial massage with Gene, 60 minutes.

expected_behavior: Does NOT fire the availability check. Naming Gene settles standard tier — goes straight to the ADD-ON QUESTION (Dry Needling, Cupping, or Salt Scrub, or on its own), since no add-on was mentioned. No universal_router call yet.

name: ning_named_check_fires_scoped

history.text: Is Ning working tomorrow for a one-hour remedial massage?

expected_behavior: Fires the availability check (Ning naming this way does NOT disqualify it — a question phrasing still counts as naming her): brief filler, then universal_router intent=category_availability_check, payload service_category="remedial_massage", requested_duration_minutes=60, practitioner_name="Ning".

name: ning_check_found_true_skips_tier_question

history.text: Is Ning working tomorrow for a one-hour remedial massage?

expected_behavior: Speaks that Ning has room tomorrow for a one-hour remedial massage, using "Ning" from available_practitioner_names as-is. Does NOT ask the standard-or-premium tier question (already settled — Ning is premium). Asks the ADD-ON QUESTION next (Dry Needling, Cupping, Salt Scrub, or on its own) since that's still unresolved for Remedial Massage.

name: ning_check_found_false_offers_correct_escapes

history.text: Is Ning working tomorrow for a one-hour remedial massage?

expected_behavior: Tells the caller plainly that Ning doesn't have room tomorrow for that. Offers checking a different day, checking with the OTHER (standard) therapists instead, or checking the other treatment (Relaxation/Classic Massage) with Ning — does NOT re-offer "check with Ning" (that's who was just checked).

name: pooled_check_found_false_offers_ning

history.text: Does anyone have room for a remedial massage today?

expected_behavior: Tells the caller plainly the standard therapists have no room today. Offers a different day, the other treatment, or checking with Ning (premium therapist). If the caller picks Ning, the next turn should re-run the check with practitioner_name="Ning" added, not silently assume an answer about her.
